svg.title: Tetrix, 3d arcade game
svg.desc: Plate IX. The title TETRIX, drawn as a cloud of points, because the code is not public. A rules engine, pure TypeScript, with arrows out to a renderer, a HUD and effects: they read state and write nothing back. Three modes, three graphics presets. Dashed, not built: touch controls, music, the Overdrive mechanic.
